title: #158 Dangerous Activities
prompt: Many people engage in dangerous activities, such as sky-diving, skiing and extreme motorcycling. Are you in favor of such activities or not? Why?

promptSegments.text: Many people engage in dangerous activities, such as sky-diving, skiing and extreme motorcycling.
Are you in favor of such activities or not?
